title: build-report 'Files changed' POSTHOC anchors to HEAD^..HEAD — a no-op cycle inherits the PRIOR commit's diff stats (false disclosure in an audit-bound artifact)
summary: Cycle-1479 authored zero commits, but its build-report.md POSTHOC block claimed '2 files / 238 insertions' — the stats of cycle-1477's ship commit (1d6ee809), because the anchor is HEAD^..HEAD on a base that already contains the prior cycle's landed work. Audit verdict WARN M2 (batch-20260815c). A no-op cycle thus presents another cycle's productivity in a ship-gate-bound artifact — the proxy-as-evidence family. SECOND VARIANT same batch: cycle-1480 audit L1 — POSTHOC metrics/files-changed left as literal 'pending' placeholder, never substituted. The writer has two failure shapes: wrong anchor (1479) and unsubstituted template (1480); fix both at the same site with the same base-SHA-sourced ground truth.
root_cause: The POSTHOC diff summarizer keys on relative revision syntax (HEAD^..HEAD) instead of the cycle's own base ref. Correct on cycles that commit; wrong on cycles that don't (inherits whatever the tip commit was) and wrong on multi-commit cycles (undercounts).
fix: Audit prescription verbatim (cycle-1479 audit-report.md): anchor the POSTHOC to the cycle base (git diff --numstat <cycle_base_sha>..HEAD, base recorded at worktree provisioning) and emit 0 files when the cycle authored no commit. The base SHA already exists in run state (worktree provisioning records it); thread it to the report writer instead of the relative anchor. Regression tests: (a) no-commit cycle => 0 files, never the parent's stats; (b) one-commit cycle => that commit's stats; (c) two-commit cycle => cumulative stats.
files: go/internal/phases/build/ (POSTHOC Files-changed writer — locate via grep 'Files changed' / 'POSTHOC')
acceptance: Table-driven regression: no-commit / one-commit / multi-commit worktree fixtures produce 0 / exact / cumulative stats; the HEAD^ inheritance shape is pinned red-first.
Cycle base SHA sourced from run state, not recomputed via relative revs.
Placeholder shape pinned: a report writer that fails to substitute POSTHOC emits 0/absent with a loud log line, never the literal 'pending' template text (red-first on the cycle-1480 shape).

Evidence-integrity adjacent: the false stat rode INTO an audit artifact and the auditor caught it by re-deriving — the fix makes the artifact honest at the source. Three cycles, two shapes, one writer: this is now the batch's most recurrent defect; consider raising priority at triage.
